invariants.statement: The candidate serves only same-origin HTML, CSS, JavaScript, fonts, images, authored data, and API responses; every remote runtime request and effect is forbidden.
acceptance_obligations: Browser evidence records zero non-same-origin requests across every configured checkpoint and task journey.
The asset closure is complete and served files contain no forbidden remote-origin references.

invariants.statement: A deterministic reset restores the database to the exact seeded state (seed id, fixtures, and migration version), so evaluation can always start from an equivalent initial state; equal inputs yield equal outputs across runs.
acceptance_obligations: Resetting twice yields the same business state while preserving the migration ledger.
The seeded housing catalog, sublet fixture, and test accounts are byte-stable across resets.

invariants.statement: An account is identified by a unique verified email address; registration with an existing email is rejected with a validation message, and one email can never log into another account.
acceptance_obligations: A second registration with an existing email fails with the documented validation message.
Login with account A credentials never yields account B's session.

invariants.statement: Sessions are bound to a single account; logging out invalidates the session, and a second user's session never observes the first user's postings, favorites, or saved searches.
acceptance_obligations: Logout invalidates the session and stateful pages require sign-in again.
Cross-account reads of postings/favorites/searches return a permission prompt, never foreign data.

invariants.statement: The session cookie is derived from the site_id, is Host-only, HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite, carries the __Host- prefix, and never sets a parent-domain Domain attribute.
acceptance_obligations: The Set-Cookie header matches the documented attributes exactly.
No parent-domain cookie is ever issued.

invariants.statement: Only the owner of a posting may edit, renew, repost, or delete it; an anonymous or non-owner actor receives a permission prompt and no mutation occurs.
acceptance_obligations: Anonymous edit/renew/repost/delete attempts return the sign-in permission prompt.
Non-owner authenticated attempts return a permission prompt and change nothing.

invariants.statement: A posting requires a non-empty title, a numeric non-negative price, a category, a location, and a description; submission with missing or invalid fields surfaces inline validation and persists nothing.
acceptance_obligations: Empty title, invalid price, and missing description each render the documented inline error.
A rejected submission creates no posting row.

invariants.statement: A published posting is immediately visible in the corresponding region/category listing and in search results matching its price, neighborhood, and category filters; a draft or removed posting is not.
acceptance_obligations: The published sublet appears in /toronto/housing/sub/ and in the matching housing search.
A deleted posting leaves search results and its detail URL renders the removed state.

invariants.statement: Each posting has a stable immutable numeric id and canonical detail URL (/<region>/<category>/d/<id>/<slug>); editing never changes the id or canonical path.
acceptance_obligations: Editing a posting keeps its id and canonical URL unchanged.
Repost creates a new id while the original remains.

invariants.statement: Postings, favorites, and saved searches persist across page refresh and across logout/login of the same account; data is stored in the site SQLite database, not in the browser.
acceptance_obligations: A favorite/saved search created while signed in is present after refresh and after re-login.
A posting published before logout is present in account history after re-login.

invariants.statement: Search and filter results are deterministic functions of the seeded data and the query parameters (query, min_price, max_price, neighborhood, posted date window, category); equal inputs yield equal outputs across runs.
acceptance_obligations: Identical query strings return identical result sets and ordering across resets.
Filters (price, neighborhood, posted today, bedrooms, housing type) narrow the seeded set exactly as documented.

invariants.statement: A search with no matches (for example the seeded impossible query zzzz-no-match-websitebench) renders a no-results message and a route back to the housing listing/search surface; it never renders a false result set.
acceptance_obligations: The impossible query renders the no-results message with zero result rows.
The return-to-search route restores the housing search surface.

invariants.statement: Registration is rate limited: the same email may register at most once per five-minute window; a second attempt in the window is rejected with an explicit message (testable via the controllable clock).
acceptance_obligations: A second registration attempt for the same email within the window is rejected with the documented message.
Advancing the controllable clock past the window permits a new attempt.

invariants.statement: Password recovery issues a single-use, expiring token delivered only to the local outbox for the account's email; submitting an expired or reused token fails, and no reset message is sent for an unknown email.
acceptance_obligations: Submitting an expired or reused token renders the expired state with a re-request link.
An unknown email receives the same neutral sent state and no outbox message.

invariants.statement: Every mutation form performs server-side validation and returns inline field-level errors matching the same semantics as the client-side checks; empty required fields and signed-out stateful actions render a validation or permission prompt identifying what must be corrected.
acceptance_obligations: Client-side and server-side validation agree on the documented error copy.
Signed-out stateful actions render the sign-in permission prompt.

invariants.statement: A user sees only their own postings, favorites, saved searches, and account history; cross-account access attempts are denied at the server.
acceptance_obligations: User A never sees user B's postings, favorites, or saved searches in any response.
Direct URL access to another user's posting-management action is denied.
